name: fos_resolution_mix
tests: L15 (R~250, reaching 2511 A) co-added with H27 (R~1300, 2222-3277 A) across C IV at 2519 A observed, plus one H19: a factor-of-five resolution mix in the measurement window.  This is the defect that spectrum_overrides.csv drops L15 for on index 150.
trimmed: 3 of the object's 5 exposures: the H27 that carries C IV, the L15 that mixes with it, and one H19.  AN EARLIER TRIM TOOK THE FIRST TWO FILES ALPHABETICALLY, WHICH WERE BOTH H19, SO THE FIXTURE COVERED 1120-1422 A REST AND HELD NO C IV AT ALL -- it could not test what it names.  Found by looking at the spectra rather than the numbers, 2026-11-14.
note_on_staging: Taken from the MAST tree, NOT from pipeline_output/chosen_visit/stage, because the staged visit has already had L15 removed by the hand override -- so a fixture built from the staged files could never exercise the mixing it exists to test.
